entries.zh: 勒逼；强逼，勒索；纠缠不放
entries.en: to press, coerce; to extort; to importune, urge persistently

entries.zh: 逼迫；强迫，催逼（恳切劝逼使来）
entries.en: to press, compel; to urge importunately with entreaties
entries.notes: R栏截断（comedimien…）且首音节有污损号，闽稿后二音节对字不明，主义按「迫」与西注 comedimiento（恳劝）取。

entries.zh: 催促；急迫催逼
entries.en: to urge, press; to hasten importunately

entries.zh: 局促；拘迫窘束，局促不安
entries.en: cramped, confined; constrained, ill at ease

entries.zh: 掩；遮掩、掩藏〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to cover, conceal; to screen (partial reading; sense doubtful)
entries.notes: 闽稿次词 ingietariog 有污损号且不可解，R栏空，仅据「掩」字取遮掩义。

entries.zh: 扔；抛掷、丢掷〔字辨与对音存疑，暂拟〕
entries.en: to throw, toss (character doubtful; provisional)
entries.notes: 字头在扐/扔之间存疑，闽稿 lia-tça 与单字对位不明，暂按「扔」取义。

entries.zh: 唠叨烦扰；纠缠絮聒不休
entries.en: to nag, pester; to trouble importunately
entries.notes: 「劳造」非习见复合词，据西注词头与闽稿 lo-cho 取唠叨烦扰、纠缠不休义。

entries.zh: 烦劳；劳苦纠缠〔次字辨存疑，暂拟〕
entries.en: to weary, trouble; to importune (second character doubtful; provisional)
entries.notes: 次字楷/楛存疑且其音节有污损号，仅按「劳」字取烦扰义。

entries.zh: 百般劝教；再三催劝不休（或作「百叩」哀恳）
entries.en: to admonish and urge over and over; to importune insistently
entries.notes: 西注续文 malcauten fa disco 未得确解，据词头 importunar 与「百教」取反复劝催义。

entries.zh: 钳粘；黏缠不放，缠住不休
entries.en: to cling and hold fast; to pester without letting go
entries.notes: 「钳粘」非习用复合词，按字面（钳制＋黏附）与词头 importunar 取黏缠不放义。

entries.zh: 局促；拘束窘迫，局促不安
entries.en: cramped, constrained; uneasy, hemmed in

entries.zh: 清澈；澄澈见底，透彻〔首字辨存疑〕
entries.en: clear, limpid (of water); thorough, penetrating (first character doubtful)
entries.notes: 首字湄/渭存疑，闽稿 to-fiev 对位不明，按「澈」取清澈义（湄/渭皆从水，故取水清义）。

entries.zh: 重言；再三向主人（物主）言说，反复叮嘱
entries.en: to repeat one's words; to tell the owner or master many times over
entries.notes: 闽稿音节与「重言」对位不明，据西注明注（向主人多次言之）与汉字「重言」取义。

entries.zh: 缠死人；把人缠扰至死（西注明言害死一人）
entries.en: to pester a man to death; to hound a man (Sp. 'to kill a man')
entries.notes: 汉字「撿死人」与西注 matar a un hombre 不合，闽稿 guiau sy lang 疑即「搅死人」之记音，按缠扰致死取义。

entries.zh: 债迫；因债催逼，逼债催讨
entries.en: to press over a debt; to dun, demand payment importunately

entries.zh: 浸渍；泡浸（药）酒〔次字辨存疑〕
entries.en: to steep, soak; to steep wine (with herbs), infuse
entries.notes: 次字清/湫存疑，闽稿 chiu 疑为「酒」，按「浸酒（泡渍）」取义。

entries.zh: 错冒；错认冒认，误认错冒
entries.en: to mistake and falsely assume; to misidentify, take wrongly
entries.notes: 西注 in quieras 未得确解，按「错＋冒」字面取错认冒认义。

entries.zh: 吵死人；吵嚷不休，扰害至人死地
entries.en: to clamor at a man without cease; to pester to death
entries.notes: 首字噪/吵存疑且前二音节有污损号，据闽稿 cho-sy-lang 与西注 matar a un… 取吵扰致死义。

entries.zh: 推迫；催逼相迫，好言恳劝相逼
entries.en: to push and press; to urge on with courteous entreaties

entries.zh: 推拒；推搪排却〔释义暂拟〕
entries.en: to push aside, fend off; to decline (provisional)
entries.notes: 首音节有污损号且西注残乱，「推併」疑即「推摒」（推却），暂拟推拒义。

entries.zh: 倚东倚西；东靠西靠，处处倚赖
entries.en: to lean now east, now west; to shift one's dependence from one to another

entries.zh: 缝之人；缝衣做针线之人，裁缝〔释义存疑〕
entries.en: one who sews; a tailor or seamstress
entries.notes: 西语词头 Ymportuno 与汉字「缝之人」语义无法接合，仅据汉字与闽稿 sy-sy-lang 取缝纫之人义。

entries.zh: 糊；浆糊、糊状之物〔首字辨存疑，暂拟〕
entries.en: paste, mush; gruel (first character doubtful; provisional)
entries.notes: 首字錡/銓存疑，西注尾词 wagez 未解，仅按「糊」取浆糊、糊状物义。
